issuer: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan / Embassy of Japan

notes.en: MOFA visa application form photo box: 45 mm × 35 mm (or 2 in × 1.4 in), recorded here as 35 mm wide × 45 mm high. Embassy of Japan in Trinidad and Tobago (official mission page): one passport photograph 45 mm × 35 mm taken within the last six months with a white background. Pixel size, file limits, DPI, colour vs grayscale, and head ratio are not stated on those pages. Some missions also accept 45×45 mm; check the mission that will receive the application.
notes.zh: 外务省签证申请表贴相片处：45 mm × 35 mm（或 2 in × 1.4 in），本条记为宽 35 mm × 高 45 mm。日本驻特立尼达和多巴哥大使馆官方页：一张 45 mm × 35 mm 护照照片，近 6 个月内拍摄，白底。上述页未写像素、文件限制、DPI、是否必须彩色与头部比例。部分馆也接受 45×45 mm，以受理馆为准。
